name: @agent-workspace/desktop
description: Independent cross-platform agent workspace desktop application
author: Agent Workspace contributors

scripts.package:linux: electron-vite build && electron-builder --linux AppImage deb rpm --x64 && pnpm release:checksums && pnpm release:verify
scripts.package:linux:local: electron-vite build && electron-builder --linux AppImage --x64 --publish never -c.directories.output=../../target/local-appimage && node scripts/install-local-appimage.mjs --appimage ../../target/local-appimage/agent-workspace-0.1.0-x86_64.AppImage --icon build/icons/512x512.png --runtime ../../target/node-linux
scripts.package:linux:updates: electron-vite build && electron-builder --linux AppImage deb rpm --x64 --publish never -c.publish.provider=generic -c.publish.url="$AGENT_WORKSPACE_UPDATE_BUILD_URL" -c.publish.channel="$AGENT_WORKSPACE_UPDATE_BUILD_CHANNEL" -c.publish.publishAutoUpdate=true && pnpm release:checksums && pnpm release:verify
scripts.package:mac: electron-vite build && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --x64 --publish never
scripts.test: vitest run && pnpm test:release-artifacts && pnpm test:local-appimage && pnpm test:native-packaging && pnpm test:package-scripts && pnpm test:performance:helpers && pnpm test:electron-shutdown
scripts.test:m5: vitest run src/main/browser-automation-manager.test.ts src/main/browser-automation-provider.test.ts src/main/browser-view-manager.test.ts && playwright test e2e/browser-automation.spec.mjs --workers=1 --timeout=180000
scripts.test:e2e: playwright test e2e --workers=1 --timeout=30000 --grep-invert="qualifies the packaged release"
